items.quote: Calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient (r) to assess the strength and direction of the linear relationship between number of cases and number of deaths.
items.description: 以完整資料（不分國家或年份）重算 'No. of cases' 與 'No. of deaths' 兩欄的 Pearson 相關係數，與 answer.txt 的 @correlation_coefficient 值比對；兩欄需先從字串轉為 Int64 後計算，結果四捨五入到兩位小數。

items.quote: @correlation_coefficient[r_value] where "r_value" is a number between -1 and 1, rounded to two decimal places.
items.description: answer.txt 中答案項須為 @correlation_coefficient[數值] 格式，值為 -1 到 1 之間的數字，四捨五入至兩位小數。

items.quote: Write your final answer to `answer.txt` in the root of this workspace.
items.description: 最終答案須寫入工作區根目錄的 answer.txt，且含 @correlation_coefficient 鍵值（數字型別）。
